PRECEDES: (Elucidation) precedes is a relation between occurrents o, o' such that if t is the temporal extent of o & t' is the temporal extent of o' then either the last instant of o is before the first instant of o' or the last instant of o is the first instant of o' & neither o nor o' are temporal instants. Its inverse is 'preceded by'. Transitive.

ENVIRONS: B environs c =Def c occurs in b. Its inverse is 'occurs in'.

ENVIRONS: B environs c =Def c occurs in b. Its inverse is 'occurs in'.

SPECIFICALLY_DEPENDS_ON: (Elucidation) specifically depends on is a relation between a specifically dependent continuant b and specifically dependent continuant or independent continuant that is not a spatial region c such that b and c share no parts in common & b is of a nature such that at all times t it cannot exist unless c exists & b is not a boundary of c. Its inverse is 'specifically depended on by'.
INHERES_IN: B inheres in c =Def b is a specifically dependent continuant & c is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & b specifically depends on c. Its inverse is 'bearer of'.

SPECIFICALLY_DEPENDS_ON: (Elucidation) specifically depends on is a relation between a specifically dependent continuant b and specifically dependent continuant or independent continuant that is not a spatial region c such that b and c share no parts in common & b is of a nature such that at all times t it cannot exist unless c exists & b is not a boundary of c. Its inverse is 'specifically depended on by'.

OCCUPIES_TEMPORAL_REGION: P occupies temporal region t =Def p is a process or process boundary & the spatiotemporal region occupied by p temporally projects onto t. Its inverse is 'is temporal region of'. Each Process has at most one TemporalRegion.

OCCUPIES_TEMPORAL_REGION: P occupies temporal region t =Def p is a process or process boundary & the spatiotemporal region occupied by p temporally projects onto t. Its inverse is 'is temporal region of'. Each ProcessBoundary has at most one TemporalRegion.

OCCUPIES_SPATIOTEMPORAL_REGION: (Elucidation) occupies spatiotemporal region is a relation between a process or process boundary p and the spatiotemporal region s which is its spatiotemporal extent. Each Process has at most one SpatiotemporalRegion.

OCCUPIES_SPATIOTEMPORAL_REGION: (Elucidation) occupies spatiotemporal region is a relation between a process or process boundary p and the spatiotemporal region s which is its spatiotemporal extent. Each ProcessBoundary has at most one SpatiotemporalRegion.

OCCUPIES_SPATIAL_REGION: B occupies spatial region r =Def b is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & r is a spatial region & there is some time t such that every continuant part of b occupies some continuant part of r at t and no continuant part of b occupies any spatial region that is not a continuant part of r at t.

OCCUPIES_SPATIAL_REGION: B occupies spatial region r =Def b is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & r is a spatial region & there is some time t such that every continuant part of b occupies some continuant part of r at t and no continuant part of b occupies any spatial region that is not a continuant part of r at t. Every 'occupies spatial region' of a Site is a ThreeDimensionalSpatialRegion.
SPATIALLY_PROJECTS_ONTO: (Elucidation) spatially projects onto is a relation between some spatiotemporal region b and spatial region c such that at some time t, c is the spatial extent of b at t.

HAS_MATERIAL_BASIS: B has material basis c =Def b is a disposition & c is a material entity & there is some d bearer of b & there is some time t such that c is a continuant part of d at t & d has disposition b because c is a continuant part of d at t. Its inverse is 'material basis of'.
HAS_FIRST_INSTANT: T has first instant t' =Def t' first instant of t. Its inverse is 'first instant of'. Each TemporalRegion has at most one TemporalInstant.
HAS_LAST_INSTANT: T has last instant t' =Def t' last instant of t. Its inverse is 'last instant of'. Each TemporalRegion has at most one TemporalInstant.

HAS_PROCESS_PART: X has process part y =Def y is part of process x. Its inverse is 'is part of process'. Every ElectromagneticWaveProcess has one or more 'has process part' that is a TransverseWaveProfile.
HAS_PROCESS_PART: X has process part y =Def y is part of process x. Its inverse is 'is part of process'. Every RotationalMotion has one or more 'has process part' that is an AngularVelocity.
HAS_PROCESS_PART: X has process part y =Def y is part of process x. Its inverse is 'is part of process'. Every ShearWaveProcess has one or more 'has process part' that is a TransverseWaveProfile.
HAS_PROCESS_PART: X has process part y =Def y is part of process x. Its inverse is 'is part of process'. Every SoundWaveProcess has one or more 'has process part' that is a LongitudinalWaveProfile.

HAS_PROCESS_PART: X has process part y =Def y is part of process x. Its inverse is 'is part of process'. Every TelemetryProcess has one or more 'has process part' that is an ActOfCommunicationByMovementOfInformationBearingArtifact.
HAS_PROCESS_PART: X has process part y =Def y is part of process x. Its inverse is 'is part of process'. Every TelemetryProcess has one or more 'has process part' that is an ActOfMeasuring.
HAS_PROCESS_PART: X has process part y =Def y is part of process x. Its inverse is 'is part of process'. Every TranslationalMotion has one or more 'has process part' that is a Velocity.

HAS_PROCESS_PART: X has process part y =Def y is part of process x. Its inverse is 'is part of process'. Every UnderActiveControl has one or more 'has process part' that is an ActOfArtifactEmployment.

HAS_PROCESS_PART: X has process part y =Def y is part of process x. Its inverse is 'is part of process'. Every VisibleObservation has one or more 'has process part' that is a VisibleLightReflectionProcess.
HAS_OBJECT: X has object y =Def y is object of x. Its inverse is 'is object of'. Every Target has one or more 'is object of' that is an ActOfTargeting.

HAS_INSIDE_INSTANT: X has_inside_instant y iff x is an instance of One Dimensional Temporal Region and y is an instance of Temporal Instant and y is_inside_instant_of x. Its inverse is 'is inside instant of'.

HAS_ALL_MEMBERS_LOCATED_IN: X has all members located in y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of independent continuant but not a spatial region, and every member of x is located in y.

HAS_SOME_MEMBER_LOCATED_IN: X has some member located in y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of independent continuant but not a spatial region, and at least one member of x is located in y.
COINCIDES_WITH: X coincides_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x is a spatial part of y and y is a spatial part of x.
PARTIALLY_OVERLAPS_WITH: X partially overlaps with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x overlaps with y and x is not a spatial part of y and y is not a spatial part of x.
CONNECTED_WITH: X is_connected_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and there exists an instance of Immaterial Entity z that is part of both x and y.
DISCONNECTED_WITH: X disconnected_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and there does not exist some immaterial entity z that is part of both x and y.
HAS_SPATIAL_PART: X has spatial part y =Def y spatial part of x. Its inverse is 'spatial part of'.
HAS_TANGENTIAL_PART: X has tangential part y =Def y tangential part of x. Its inverse is 'tangential part of'.
EXTERNALLY_CONNECTS_WITH: X externally_connects_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x connects with y and x does not overlap y.
HAS_NONTANGENTIAL_PART: X has nontangential part y =Def y nontangential part of x. Its inverse is 'nontangential part of'.
HAS_SUBSIDIARY: X has subsidiary y =Def y is subsidiary of x. Its inverse is 'is subsidiary of'.
HAS_INSIDE_INTERVAL: X has inside interval y =Def y interval during x. Its inverse is 'interval during'. Every Hour has one or more 'interval during' that is a Day.
HAS_INSIDE_INTERVAL: X has inside interval y =Def y interval during x. Its inverse is 'interval during'. Every Year has one or more 'interval during' that is a Decade.
HAS_INSIDE_INTERVAL: X has inside interval y =Def y interval during x. Its inverse is 'interval during'. Every Minute has one or more 'interval during' that is a Hour.
HAS_INSIDE_INTERVAL: X has inside interval y =Def y interval during x. Its inverse is 'interval during'. Every Second has one or more 'interval during' that is a Minute.
HAS_INSIDE_INTERVAL: X has inside interval y =Def y interval during x. Its inverse is 'interval during'. Every Week has one or more 'interval during' that is a Month.
HAS_INSIDE_INTERVAL: X has inside interval y =Def y interval during x. Its inverse is 'interval during'.

INTERVAL_FINISHES: X interval_finishes y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant v, w, and z such that v is the starting instant of x, w is the ending instant of both x and y, z is the starting instant of y, and z is before v. Its inverse is 'interval finished by'.

INTERVAL_EQUALS: X interval_equals y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant w and z such that w is the starting instant of both x and y and z is the ending instant of both x and y. Symmetric.
INTERVAL_OVERLAPS: X interval overlaps y =Def y interval overlapped by x. Its inverse is 'interval overlapped by'.
INTERVAL_DISJOINT: X interval_disjoint y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and have no parts in common.
INTERVAL_MEETS: X interval meets y =Def y interval met by x.
INTERVAL_MET_BY: X interval_met_by y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and y interval_meets x.

INTERVAL_STARTS: X interval_starts y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant v, w, and z such that v is the starting instant of both x and y, w is the ending instant of x, z is the ending instant of y and w is before z. Its inverse is 'interval started by'.
INTERVAL_CONTAINS: X interval contains y =Def y interval contained by x. Its inverse is 'interval contained by'.

INTERVAL_IS_BEFORE: X interval_is_before y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant w, z such that w is the ending instant of x and z is the starting instant of y and w is before z. Its inverse is 'interval is after'.
HAS_INSIDE_INTERVAL: X has inside interval y =Def y interval during x. Its inverse is 'interval during'. Every Day has one or more 'interval during' that is a Week.
HAS_INSIDE_INTERVAL: X has inside interval y =Def y interval during x. Its inverse is 'interval during'. Every Month has one or more 'interval during' that is a Year.
ROLE_OF_AGGREGATE: X role_of_aggregate y iff y is an instance of Object Aggregate and x is an instance of Role, and x inheres_in_aggregate y.

PROHIBITS: X prohibits y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that some y must not occur. Its inverse is 'is prohibited by'. Every ProcessProhibition has one or more 'prohibits' that is a Process.

PROHIBITS: X prohibits y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that some y must not occur. Its inverse is 'is prohibited by'.
PERMITS: X permits y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that y may occur. Its inverse is 'is permitted by'.
REQUIRES: X requires y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that some y must occur. Its inverse is 'is required by'.

IS_ABOUT: X is_about y is a primitive relationship between an instance of Information Content Entity x and an instance of Entity y. Its inverse is 'is subject of'. Every InformationContentEntity has one or more 'is about' that is an Entity.

INHERES_IN_AGGREGATE: X inheres_in_aggregate y iff x is an instance of Specifically Dependent Continuant or Generically Dependent Continuant and y is an instance of Object Aggregate and y aggregate_bearer_of x. Its inverse is 'aggregate bearer of'.

INHERES_IN_AGGREGATE: X inheres_in_aggregate y iff x is an instance of Specifically Dependent Continuant or Generically Dependent Continuant and y is an instance of Object Aggregate and y aggregate_bearer_of x. Its inverse is 'aggregate bearer of'.

USES: X uses y iff x is an instance of an Agent and y is an instance of a Material Entity, such that both x and y participate in some instance of a Process wherein x attempts to accomplish a goal by manipulating, deploying, or leveraging some attribute of y. Its inverse is 'is used by'.
CAUSED_BY: X caused by y =Def y is cause of x. Its inverse is 'is cause of'. Every ActOfHomicide has one or more 'is cause of' that is a Death.
CAUSED_BY: X caused by y =Def y is cause of x. Its inverse is 'is cause of'. Every ActOfSuicide has one or more 'is cause of' that is a Death.
CAUSED_BY: X caused by y =Def y is cause of x. Its inverse is 'is cause of'. Every Effect has one or more 'caused by' that is a Process.
CAUSED_BY: X caused by y =Def y is cause of x. Its inverse is 'is cause of'. Every EffectOfLocationChange has one or more 'caused by' that is an ActOfLocationChange.
CAUSED_BY: X caused by y =Def y is cause of x. Its inverse is 'is cause of'. Every Cause has one or more 'is cause of' that is a Process.
CAUSED_BY: X caused by y =Def y is cause of x. Its inverse is 'is cause of'. Every StasisOfNonMissionCapableMaintenance has one or more 'caused by' that is an ActOfMaintenance.

IS_EXCERPTED_FROM: An Information Bearing Entity b1 is excerpted from another Information Bearing Entity B2 iff b1 is part of some Information Bearing Entity B1 that is carrier of some Information Content Entity C1, B2 is carrier of some Information Content Entity C2, C1 is not identical with C2, b1 is carrier of some Information Content Entity c1, b2 is an Information Bearing Entity that is part of B2 and b2 is carrier of c1 (i.e. the same Information Content Entity as borne by b1).
HAS_ACCOMPLICE: X has accomplice y =Def y accomplice in x. Its inverse is 'accomplice in'.
HAS_AGENT: X has agent y =Def y agent in x. Its inverse is 'agent in'.
HAS_ACCESSORY: X has accessory y =Def y accessory in x. Its inverse is 'accessory in'.
HAS_SENDER: X has sender y =Def y sends x. Its inverse is 'sends'.
HAS_RECIPIENT: X has recipient y =Def y receives x. Its inverse is 'receives'.

HAS_SPATIAL_PART: X has spatial part y =Def y spatial part of x. Its inverse is 'spatial part of'. Every ObjectTrack has one or more 'has spatial part' that is an ObjectTrackPoint. Every ObjectTrackPoint has one or more 'spatial part of' that is an ObjectTrack.
HAS_SPATIAL_PART: X has spatial part y =Def y spatial part of x. Its inverse is 'spatial part of'. Every ThreeDimensionalPath has one or more 'has spatial part' that is a ThreeDimensionalPosition.

HAS_SPATIAL_PART: X has spatial part y =Def y spatial part of x. Its inverse is 'spatial part of'. Every VehicleTrack has one or more 'has spatial part' that is a VehicleTrackPoint. Every VehicleTrackPoint has one or more 'spatial part of' that is a VehicleTrack.
USES_MEASUREMENT_UNIT: X uses measurement unit y =Def y is measurement unit of x. Its inverse is 'is measurement unit of'.
DELIMITS: X delimits y =Def y is delimited by x. Its inverse is 'is delimited by'. Every Government has one or more 'is delimited by' that is a DelimitingDomain.
DELIMITS: X delimits y =Def y is delimited by x. Its inverse is 'is delimited by'. Every DelimitingDomain has one or more 'delimits' that is an Organization.
DELIMITS: X delimits y =Def y is delimited by x. Its inverse is 'is delimited by'. Every GovernmentOfACountry has one or more 'is delimited by' that is a DomainOfACountry.
DELIMITS: X delimits y =Def y is delimited by x. Its inverse is 'is delimited by'. Every GovernmentDomain has one or more 'delimits' that is a Government.
AGGREGATE_HAS_CAPABILITY: X aggregate has capability y =Def y capability of aggregate x. Its inverse is 'capability of aggregate'.
AGGREGATE_HAS_ROLE: X aggregate_has_role y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of Role, such that x aggregate_bearer_of y.

AGGREGATE_HAS_QUALITY: X aggregate_has_quality y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of Quality, such that x aggregate_bearer_of y. Every EthnicGroup has one or more 'aggregate has quality' that is an Ethnicity.
AGGREGATE_HAS_QUALITY: X aggregate_has_quality y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of Quality, such that x aggregate_bearer_of y.
USES_TIME_ZONE_IDENTIFIER: X uses time zone identifier y =Def y time zone identifier used by x. Its inverse is 'time zone identifier used by'.

PERMITS: X permits y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that y may occur. Its inverse is 'is permitted by'. Every ActionPermission has one or more 'permits' that is a Process.
USES_REFERENCE_SYSTEM: X uses reference system y =Def y is reference system of x. Its inverse is 'is reference system of'.

USES_GEOSPATIAL_COORDINATE_REFERENCE_SYSTEM: X uses geospatial coordinate reference system y =Def y is geospatial coordinate reference system of x. Its inverse is 'is geospatial coordinate reference system of'.

IS_MEASURED_BY_NOMINAL: X is measured by nominal y =Def y is a nominal measurement of x. Its inverse is 'is a nominal measurement of'. Every NominalMeasurementInformationContentEntity has one or more 'is a nominal measurement of' that is an Entity.

DESIGNATES: X designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Every ArtifactIdentifier has one or more 'designates' that is a MaterialArtifact.

DESIGNATES: X designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Every ArtifactModelName has one or more 'designates' that is an ArtifactModel.

DESIGNATES: X designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Every DateIdentifier has one or more 'designates' that is a Day.

DESIGNATES: X designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Every DesignativeInformationContentEntity has one or more 'designates' that is an Entity.

DESIGNATES: X designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Every JulianDateIdentifier has one or more 'designates' that is a JulianDate.

DESIGNATES: X designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Every JulianDayNumber has one or more 'designates' that is a JulianDay.

DESIGNATES: X designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Every SpatialRegionIdentifier has one or more 'designates' that is a SpatialRegion.

DESIGNATES: X designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Every TemporalInstantIdentifier has one or more 'designates' that is a TemporalInstant.

DESIGNATES: X designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Every TemporalIntervalIdentifier has one or more 'designates' that is an OneDimensionalTemporalRegion.

DESIGNATES: X designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Every TemporalRegionIdentifier has one or more 'designates' that is a TemporalRegion.

DESIGNATES: X designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Every TimeOfDayIdentifier has one or more 'designates' that is a TimeOfDay.
OCCURS_AT: X occurs_at y iff x is an instance of Process and y is an instance of Site, such that x occurs in y. Its inverse is 'is site of'.
IS_MENTIONED_BY: X is_mentioned_by y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Entity, such that y is used as a reference to x. Its inverse is 'is mention of'.
INTERVAL_CONTAINS: X interval contains y =Def y interval contained by x. Its inverse is 'interval contained by'. Every MultiDayTemporalInterval has one or more 'interval contains' that is a Day.
INTERVAL_CONTAINS: X interval contains y =Def y interval contained by x. Its inverse is 'interval contained by'. Every MultiHourTemporalInterval has one or more 'interval contains' that is a Hour.

INTERVAL_CONTAINS: X interval contains y =Def y interval contained by x. Its inverse is 'interval contained by'. Every MultiMinuteTemporalInterval has one or more 'interval contains' that is a Minute.
INTERVAL_CONTAINS: X interval contains y =Def y interval contained by x. Its inverse is 'interval contained by'. Every MultiMonthTemporalInterval has one or more 'interval contains' that is a Month.

INTERVAL_CONTAINS: X interval contains y =Def y interval contained by x. Its inverse is 'interval contained by'. Every MultiSecondTemporalInterval has one or more 'interval contains' that is a Second.
INTERVAL_CONTAINS: X interval contains y =Def y interval contained by x. Its inverse is 'interval contained by'. Every MultiWeekTemporalInterval has one or more 'interval contains' that is a Week.
INTERVAL_CONTAINS: X interval contains y =Def y interval contained by x. Its inverse is 'interval contained by'. Every MultiYearTemporalInterval has one or more 'interval contains' that is a Year.

REPRESENTS: X represents y iff x is an instance of Representational Information Content Entity, y is an instance of Entity, and z is carrier of x, such that x is about y in virtue of there existing an isomorphism between characteristics of z and y. Its inverse is 'represented by'. Every RepresentationalInformationContentEntity has one or more 'represents' that is an Entity.

PRESCRIBES: X prescribes y iff x is an instance of Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x serves as a rule or guide for y if y an Occurrent, or x serves as a model for y if y is a Continuant. Its inverse is 'prescribed by'. Every ArtifactDesign has one or more 'prescribes' that is a MaterialArtifact.

PRESCRIBES: X prescribes y iff x is an instance of Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x serves as a rule or guide for y if y an Occurrent, or x serves as a model for y if y is a Continuant. Its inverse is 'prescribed by'. Every ArtifactFunctionSpecification has one or more 'prescribes' that is an ArtifactFunction.

PRESCRIBES: X prescribes y iff x is an instance of Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x serves as a rule or guide for y if y an Occurrent, or x serves as a model for y if y is a Continuant. Its inverse is 'prescribed by'. Every PrescriptiveInformationContentEntity has one or more 'prescribes' that is an Entity.

PRESCRIBES: X prescribes y iff x is an instance of Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x serves as a rule or guide for y if y an Occurrent, or x serves as a model for y if y is a Continuant. Its inverse is 'prescribed by'. Every QualitySpecification has one or more 'prescribes' that is a Quality.
SUPERVISES: X supervises y =Def y is supervised by x. Its inverse is 'is supervised by'.
QUALITY_OF_AGGREGATE: X quality_of_aggregate y iff y is an instance of Object Aggregate and x is an instance of Quality, and x inheres_in_aggregate y.
HAS_SUBORDINATE_ROLE: X has subordinate role y =Def y is subordinate role to x. Its inverse is 'is subordinate role to'.
HAS_CAPABILITY: X has capability y =Def y capability of x. Its inverse is 'capability of'.
HAS_CAPABILITY: X has capability y =Def y capability of x. Its inverse is 'capability of'. Every OrganizationCapability has one or more 'capability of' that is an Organization.
HAS_CAPABILITY: X has capability y =Def y capability of x. Its inverse is 'capability of'. Every Skill has one or more 'capability of' that is a Person.
AGGREGATE_HAS_DISPOSITION: X aggregate has disposition y =Def y disposition of aggregate x. Its inverse is 'disposition of aggregate'.

IS_MEASURED_BY_ORDINAL: X is measured by ordinal y =Def y is a ordinal measurement of x. Its inverse is 'is an ordinal measurement of'. Every OrdinalMeasurementInformationContentEntity has one or more 'is an ordinal measurement of' that is an Entity.

IS_MEASURED_BY_INTERVAL: X is measured by interval y =Def y is a interval measurement of x. Its inverse is 'is an interval measurement of'. Every IntervalMeasurementInformationContentEntity has one or more 'is an interval measurement of' that is an Entity.

IS_A_MEASUREMENT_OF: X is_a_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x describes some attribute of y relative to some scale or classification scheme. Its inverse is 'is measured by'. Every MeasurementInformationContentEntity has one or more 'is a measurement of' that is an Entity.

REQUIRES: X requires y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that some y must occur. Its inverse is 'is required by'. Every ProcessRequirement has one or more 'requires' that is a Process.
USES_LANGUAGE: X uses language y =Def y language used in x. Its inverse is 'language used in'.
HAS_AFFILIATE: X has affiliate y =Def y is affiliated with x. Its inverse is 'is affiliated with'.
HAS_AFFILIATE: X has affiliate y =Def y is affiliated with x. Its inverse is 'is affiliated with'. Every OrganizationMember has one or more 'is affiliated with' that is an Organization.

DESCRIBES_CONDITION: P describes_condition c iff p is an instance of a Performance Specification and c is an instance of Entity and p has part d, and d is an instance of a Descriptive Information Content Entity, and p prescribes an entity s, and d describes c, and c is an entity that is causally relevant to s existing as prescribed by p. Its inverse is 'condition described by'. Every PerformanceSpecification has one or more 'describes condition' that is an Entity.

DESCRIBES: X describes y iff x is an instance of Descriptive Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of Entity, such that x is_about the characteristics that identify y. Its inverse is 'described by'. Every DescriptiveInformationContentEntity has one or more 'describes' that is an Entity.

IS_A_RATIO_MEASUREMENT_OF: X is_a_ratio_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity and x describes some attribute of y relative to a scale having equal unit values and a zero value that corresponds to the absence of the attribute being measured. Its inverse is 'is measured by ratio'. Every RatioMeasurementInformationContentEntity has one or more 'is a ratio measurement of' that is an Entity.
HAS_INTEREST_IN: A relation between an Agent and some Process where the Agent has an interest in that Process. Its inverse is 'is interest of'.

INSTANT_IS_BEFORE: X instant_is_before y iff x and y are both instances of Zero Dimensional Temporal Region and there exists some instance of Temporal Interval z such that x is the starting instant of z and y is the ending instant of z. Its inverse is 'instant is after'. Transitive.
HAS_ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT: X has organizational context y =Def y is organizational context of x. Its inverse is 'is organizational context of'.

PROCESS_HAS_FIRST_INSTANT: X process_has_first_instant y Def= x is a Process, y is a Temporal Instant, and there is some Temporal Region z such that y is first_instant_of z, and x occupies_temporal_region z. Each Process has at most one TemporalInstant.

PROCESS_HAS_LAST_INSTANT: X process_has_last_instant y Def= x is a Process, y is a Temporal Instant, and there is some Temporal Region z such that y is last_instant_of z, and x occupies_temporal_region z. Each Process has at most one TemporalInstant.

g.title: AbbreviatedName — A Designative Name that is a shortened form of a Proper Name. Properties: uri

AcademicDegree — A Certificate issued by an Educational Organization to a Person to indicate that the Person has satisfactorily completed a course of study, or as an honorary recognition of the Person's achievement. Properties: uri
Acceleration — A Process Profile that is the rate of change of the Velocity of an object. Properties: uri
Acronym — An Abbreviated Name that combines the initial letters of a Designative Name and which is pronounced as a word. Properties: uri
Act — A Process in which at least one Agent plays a causative role. Properties: uri
ActOfAdvising — An Act of Directive Communication performed by providing advice or counsel to another agent. Properties: uri
ActOfApologizing — An Act of Expressive Communication performed by acknowledging and expressing regret for a fault, shortcoming, or failure. Properties: uri
ActOfAppraisal — An Act of Measuring that involves evaluating, assessing, estimating, or judging the nature, value, importance, condition, or quality of something or someone. Properties: uri
ActOfArrival — An Act of Location Change that consists of the participating entity reaching its destination such that the larger Act of Location Change is completed. Properties: uri
ActOfArtifactAssembly — An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein a new Material Artifact are created by fitting component parts together. Properties: uri
ActOfArtifactEmployment — A Planned Act of using a Material Artifact. Properties: uri

ActOfArtifactModification — An Act of Material Artifact Processing in which an existing Material Artifact is acted upon in a manner that changes, adds, or removes one or more of its Qualities, Dispositions, or Functions. Properties: uri
ActOfAssassination — An Act of Murder of a prominent person. Properties: uri

ActOfAssignment — An Act of Declarative Communication in which rights held by one party (the assignor) are transferred to another party (the assignee) with regard to a particular entity as specified by the details of the assignment, which is often prescribed by a contract. Properties: uri
ActOfAssociation — A Social Act wherein an Agent unites with some other Agent in a Planned Act, enterprise or business. Properties: uri
ActOfBuying — An Act of Purchasing wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Buyer) to acquire ownership of a good from another Agent (the Seller). Properties: uri
ActOfCargoTransportation — An Act of Location Change wherein some Payload is moved from one location to another. Properties: uri
ActOfCensuring — An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing strong disapproval or criticism. Properties: uri
ActOfCeremony — A Social Act of ritual significance, performed on a special occasion. Properties: uri
ActOfChangeOfResidence — An Act of Location Change involving one or more Persons moving from one place of residence to another. Properties: uri
ActOfCollision — An Act of Location Change involving the movement of one object such that it collides with another object. Properties: uri
ActOfCommanding — An Act of Directive Communication through which an Agent exercises authoritative control or power over another Agent's actions. Properties: uri
ActOfCommissiveCommunication — An Act of Communication in which an Agent commits themselves to doing, or refraining from doing, some future action. Properties: uri
ActOfCommunication — A Planned Act in which the objective is to create a concretization of some Information Content Entity in one or more recipients. Properties: uri

ActOfCommunicationByMovementOfInformationBearingArtifact — An Act of Communication in which some Material Artifact is used to transfer an Information Bearing Entity from sender(s) to receiver(s). Properties: uri
ActOfCommunicationMediatedByArtifact — An Act of Communication in which technology is used to create a new copy of the Information Content Entity in the recipient. Properties: uri
ActOfCondoling — An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing sympathy or sorrow. Properties: uri

ActOfConductingMassMediaInterview — An Act of Mass Media Communication involving a conversation between a reporter and a person of public interest, used as a basis of a broadcast or publication. Properties: uri
ActOfConfessing — An Act of Representative Communication in which a person makes an admission of misdeeds or faults. Properties: uri
ActOfCongratulating — An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing vicarious pleasure to a person on the occasion of their success or good fortune. Properties: uri
ActOfConstruction — An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein Material Artifacts are built on site as prescribed by some contract. Properties: uri
ActOfConsumption — A Planned Act in which a resource is ingested or used up. Properties: uri

ActOfContractFormation — An Act of Promising having a lawful object entered into voluntarily by two or more agents with legal capacity, each of whom intends to create one or more legal obligations between them. Properties: uri

ActOfDataTransformation — An Act of Information Processing in which an algorithm is executed to act upon one or more input Information Content Entities into one or more output Information Content Entities. Properties: uri

ActOfDeceptiveCommunication — Ac Act of Communication intended to mislead the audience by distortion or falsification of evidence and induce a reaction that is prejudicial to the interests of the audience. Properties: uri
ActOfDeclarativeCommunication — An Act of Communication that changes the reality in accord with the content of the declaration. Properties: uri
ActOfDecoyUse — An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Decoy. Properties: uri
ActOfDenying — An Act of Representative Communication performed by either asserting that something is not true or real or refusing to satisfy a request or desire. Properties: uri
ActOfDeparture — An Act of Location Change that consists of the participating entity leaving its starting location such that the larger Act of Location Change is initiated. Properties: uri
ActOfDirectiveCommunication — An Act of Communication that is intended to cause the hearer to take a particular action. Properties: uri
ActOfDonating — An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is tranfered by an Agent (the Donor) to another Agent (the Recipient) without return consideration. Properties: uri

ActOfEducationalTrainingAcquisition — An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of a curriculum from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with some Educational Organization. Properties: uri

ActOfEducationalTrainingInstruction — An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Educational Organization by imparting knowledge of a curriculum to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium. Properties: uri
ActOfEmployment — An Act of Association wherein an Agent assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation. Properties: uri
ActOfEmploymentByAnOrganization — An Act of Employment wherein an Organization assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation. Properties: uri
ActOfEncounter — An Act of Association wherein two or more Persons meet in a casual or unplanned manner. Properties: uri
ActOfEntertainment — A Planned Act consisting of any activity which provides a diversion or permits people to amuse themselves. Properties: uri

ActOfEspionage — An Act of Intelligence Gathering involving the obtaining of information that is considered secret or confidential without the permission of the holder of the information. Properties: uri

ActOfEstimation — An Act of Measuring that involves the comparison of a measurement of a similar Entity or of a portion of the Entity being estimated to produce an approximated measurement of the target Entity. Properties: uri
ActOfExpressiveCommunication — An Act of Communication in which an Agent expresses their attitudes or emotions towards some entity. Properties: uri
ActOfFacilityUse — An Act of Artifact Employment in which an Agent makes use of some Facility. Properties: uri

ActOfFinancialDeposit — An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent (the Depositor) to another Agent to create a liability to be repaid to the Depositor through an Act of Financial Withdrawal. Properties: uri
ActOfFinancialInstrumentUse — An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Financial Instrument. Properties: uri

ActOfFinancialWithdrawal — An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent to another Agent (the Depositor) from an account created by an earlier Act of Financial Deposit performed by the Depositor. Properties: uri

ActOfFunding — An Act of Financial Instrument Use in which an Agent (the Funder) provides some Financial Instrument to another Agent (the recipient of the funds) as a resource pool that is earmarked by the Funder for a future transaction. Properties: uri
ActOfGovernment — A Planned Act that is initiated or supported by some Geopolitical Entity and enforced by some Government Agent. Properties: uri
ActOfHomicide — An Act of Violence which causes the unlawful killing of another person. Properties: uri
ActOfIdentifying — An Act of Representative Communication performed by asserting who or what a particular person or thing is. Properties: uri
ActOfInformationProcessing — A Planned Act in which one or more input Information Content Entities are received, manipulated, transferred, or stored by an Agent. Properties: uri
ActOfInhabitancy — A Planned Act in which a Person lives at a Site for a period of time that may be as short as 1 day/night or as long as the Person's entire life. Properties: uri

ActOfIntelligenceGathering — A Planned Act of producing and/or gathering information by a government or other Organization to guide decisions and actions by answering questions or obtaining advance warning of events and movements deemed to be important or otherwise relevant. Properties: uri
ActOfInterpersonalRelationship — An Act of Association between two or more Persons that may range from fleeting to enduring. Properties: uri
ActOfInviting — An Act of Commissive Communication performed by requesting the presence or participation of the audience, and which may include offering an incentive or inducement. Properties: uri
ActOfIssuing — An Act of Mass Media Communication involving sending forth, distributing, or putting into circulation some Information Content Entity. Properties: uri
ActOfIssuingMassMediaArticle — An Act of Issuing a non-fictional essay, especially one included with others in a newspaper, magazine, or journal. Properties: uri
ActOfIssuingMassMediaDocumentary — An Act of Issuing information that provides a factual record or report. Properties: uri
ActOfIssuingMassMediaPressRelease — An Act of Issuing an official statement to one or more members of the media for the purpose of announcing newsworthy information. Properties: uri
ActOfLegalInstrumentUse — An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Legal Instrument. Properties: uri

ActOfLoaning — An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is given by an Agent (the Creditor) to another Agent (the Debtor) in order to receive Repayments from the Debtor which are of greater Financial Value. Properties: uri
ActOfLocationChange — An Act of Motion in which the location of some Object is changed by some Agent. Properties: uri
ActOfMaintenance — An Act of Artifact Modification in which a Material Artifact is modified in order to preserve or restore one or more of its designed Qualities or Functions. Properties: uri
ActOfManufacturing — An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein Material Artifacts are mass produced in a Facility for the purpose of being sold or distributed to consumers. Properties: uri
ActOfMassMediaCommunication — An Act of Communication intended to reach a large audience using a medium such as the internet, television, radio, newspaper, or magazine. Properties: uri
ActOfMaterialArtifactProcessing — A Planned Act of performing a series of physical operations on a material artifact in order to change or preserve the artifact. Properties: uri
ActOfMeasuring — A Planned Act that involves determining the extent, dimensions, quanity, or quality of an Entity relative to some standard. Properties: uri

XRayMicroscope — A Microscope that is designed to use Electromagnetic Radiation in the soft X-ray band to produce a significantly enlarged image of the Object. Properties: uri
XRayTelescope — A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing X-rays to form an enhanced image of the Object. Properties: uri
YAxis — A Coordinate System Axis designated by the variable 'y'. Properties: uri

YawAxis — An Axis of Rotation that passes through the center of an object's Mass from the top to the bottom and is perpendicular to the direction of the object's motion. For objects in Orbit, the Yaw Axis passes through the Barycenter of its Orbit. Properties: uri
YawOrientation — A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Yaw Axis. Properties: uri

Year — A Temporal Interval that is equal to the approximate length of time required for an Astronomical Body to complete one Orbital Revolution around its Primary Body as specified relative to a particular Temporal Reference System. Properties: uri
Yellow — A Color that is between Orange and Green with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 560 to 590 nanometers. Properties: uri
ZAxis — A Coordinate System Axis designated by the variable 'z'. Properties: uri

Zenith — A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that extends from a given location upward along the local vertical direction pointing in the direction opposite the apparent Gravitational Force at that location. Properties: uri
ZeroDimensionalSpatialRegion — (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional spatial region is one or a collection of more than one spatially disjoint points in space. Properties: uri
ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion — (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region that is a whole consisting of one or more separated temporal instants as parts. Properties: uri
